pages.title: Press a Brick
pages.text: Use one Clay Ball on the empty mold. Empty-hand right-click twice to press, then again to collect one Unfired Clay Brick. One Refractory Clay follows the same two-press process for an Unfired Refractory Brick.

pages.title: Fire and Recover
pages.text: Fire ordinary bricks in a furnace or on a campfire; refractory bricks use a furnace. The mold never fires material. Sneak-empty-hand use retrieves unfinished input. Packs can change counts and presses; visible fill follows pressing progress.
